title: Mumbai Man Arrested For Slitting Sleeping Daughter's Neck Over Suspicion Of Wife's Affair | Mumbai-news News - News18
text: In a shocking incident, a man allegedly slit the neck of his minor daughter, suspecting his wife of having an extramarital affair. The 14-year-old girl was fast asleep when her father barged into her room and slit her neck. As the teenager cried out in pain, her mother rushed to her rescue, only to be attacked as well. The accused has been identified as Hanumant Sonawale from Mumbai. He was allegedly drunk and had a verbal altercation with his wife, Rajshree, moments before the attack. The man has been arrested by and an investigation is underway. The 14-year-old girl has got five stitches on her neck. Both mother and daughter have been admitted to Shatabdi Hospital in Kandivali and are undergoing treatment, NDTV reported. According to the initial investigation, Sonawale was unemployed and an addict, deep into alcoholism. He would often assault his wife and suspect her of having an extramarital affair, questioning her character. After one such argument, Sonawale allegedly picked up a blade and attacked his daughter early in the morning. When his wife tried to intervene, he allegedly stabbed her in the stomach. He was reportedly distressed over his wife’s recent move to seek a divorce and legal counsel. A case has been registered against the accused for attempted murder and domestic violence.
